name: Zscaler (ZS)
teaser: Do not add. Zscaler is a high-quality security platform, but the shares trade about 31% above the Base value once stock compensation is treated as a real cost. The two valuation methods diverge sharply, so a 40% margin of safety is required and the buy zone starts at $98.58.
llms: Zero Trust cloud security subscription platform whose fiscal 2026 stock compensation ($822 million) exceeded free cash flow ($779 million), valued on forward EV to revenue and free cash flow after stock compensation. Bear $148.40, Base $164.30, Bull $243.49. Verdict HOLD at $214.64 (do not add), maximum buy price $98.58.
